title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos
notes: Start the onions first; they need 20 minutes to pickle. Roast the sweet potatoes while you simmer the beans and make the guacamole. Warm the tortillas last.
Leftover pickled onions keep 2 weeks refrigerated.
For a vegan version, skip the cheese.

inputs: 2 medium (600 g) sweet potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
2 cans (15 oz. / 425 g each) black beans, drained and rinsed

inputs.op: warm in dry skillet, 30 s per side

inputs: 1/2 cup (60 g) crumbled feta or cotija
